independent_evaluation.claim_kind: independent evaluator claims, not calibrated ground truth

limitations: One creation and one independent evaluation per model; not a capability ranking.
Unverified is not failed. Separate controlled QA does not alter the historical evaluator claims.
Actual charges and subjective experience ratings are absent.
The browser/task protocol differs from Report 001; their totals are not directly comparable.

checks.title: Open and start the game
checks.observation_summary: After pressing Enter on the start screen, a 10×20 board, active piece, and score of 0 appeared.

checks.title: Automatic descent and new piece
checks.observation_summary: Without a down input, the piece kept falling, locked, and a new piece spawned.

checks.title: Horizontal movement and bounds
checks.observation_summary: Left and right keys moved the piece; further presses at both edges kept it on the board.

checks.title: Rotation
checks.observation_summary: The asymmetric Z piece changed orientation after ArrowUp and returned after a second press.

checks.title: Locking and stacking
checks.observation_summary: Hard drop landed and locked the piece; later pieces stacked on existing pieces.

checks.title: Line clearing
checks.observation_summary: A row was completed in the independent natural run; in the next frame it disappeared and the pieces above moved down.

checks.title: Scoring after a line clear
checks.observation_summary: In the same natural run, the score rose from 252 to 352 across a line clear; there was only waiting, with no hard-drop input.

checks.title: Game over when the stack reaches the top
checks.observation_summary: After repeated hard drops filled the spawn area, a game-over screen showed 450 points and 1 line.

checks.title: Restart and reset
checks.observation_summary: After restarting from game over, the board cleared, score and lines reset to zero, and play continued.

controlled_qa.setup: First three pieces I, J, L controlled before load; normal game input thereafter.

checks.title: Open and start the game
checks.observation_summary: After clicking Start, the overlay disappeared and the active piece and game controls appeared.

checks.title: Automatic descent and new piece
checks.observation_summary: Without a down input, the piece fell, locked, and the next piece spawned.

checks.title: Horizontal movement and bounds
checks.observation_summary: Left and right keys moved the piece; further presses at either boundary kept it on the board.

checks.title: Rotation
checks.observation_summary: The J piece visibly changed orientation after x or ArrowUp.

checks.title: Locking and stacking
checks.observation_summary: Repeated hard drops landed on locked pieces without passing through the stack.

checks.title: Line clearing
checks.observation_summary: The randomized run did not complete a row; the initial 1280×720 viewport also cut off the bottom of the board, so this run could not prove line clearing.

checks.title: Scoring after a line clear
checks.observation_summary: No line clear occurred in this run. Observed points came from hard drops and cannot prove scoring after a clear.

checks.title: Game over when the stack reaches the top
checks.observation_summary: After stacking to the top, a game-over screen showed 216 points.

checks.title: Restart and reset
checks.observation_summary: After restarting from game over, the old stack disappeared, the score reset to zero, and pieces kept falling and moving.

controlled_qa.setup: First three pieces I, J, L controlled before load; normal game input thereafter.
